hints.title: Independent Move Availability
hints.text: Each player can only remove pieces surrounded on both sides by their own color.

hints.title: Consecutive Triplets
hints.text: Count consecutive runs of identical colors and sum the removable pieces for each player.

hints.title: Decision Rule
hints.text: The first player wins if and only if they have strictly more valid moves available than the opponent.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) linear scan over color string
complexity.notes: Moves by one player do not create or destroy valid moves for the opponent.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Game tree search takes exponential time for independent move choices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Independent move counts allow simple arithmetic comparison.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that removals never create new three-in-a-row triplets.
